parsed.why: No trans-specific law, but regular prosecutions, sharia death penalty in regions, insurgent groups executing people accused of homosexual conduct, no rule of law, total social taboo. Structural signals resolve to catastrophic severity if outed.

No criminalisation of gender identity, third-gender recognition and pride events, but document change still onerous and documented discrimination plus frequent physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities; recourse thin.

Self-ID, X passports, working anti-discrimination and strong institutions outweigh; deducted for supreme court upholding men's-prison placement of trans women, custody assault case, hotel murder, recurring anti-trans discourse and service denials.

Hijra recognition but no anti-discrimination protection; documented police extortion, retaliatory violence and arrests of visibly trans people including at the airport, a 2025 trans murder and rising violations; state-tolerated targeting.

No criminalisation and prosecutions undocumented, but ambiguous penal article used by police to extort, no gender-identity recognition or protection, no bias-crime route and hostile social attitudes; police targeting is the decisive exposure.
